MGA/B2C/108/2004.title: Reading offshore company records alongside a gambling licence

trail.title: See the shareholders and auditor on BML’s historical Malta record

MGA/B2C/108/2004.summary: ICIJ’s historical Malta corporate registry entry records BML Group Limited’s incorporation on 21 October 2004. Its Paradise Papers registry snapshot ends in 2016. The gaming licence above has a separate status and observation date.
